source: CA DWR OSWCR well completion reports (CountyName='San Diego'), minus reports matched to a County DEHQ permit

fields.k: category: w water supply, d destruction, m monitoring/other
fields.bd: work-ended date is in the future (bad date in DWR index)
fields.sx: BLM PLSS section id (FRSTDIVID) for section-level wells; geometry in sections.json
fields.trs: DWR's own Township/Range/Section for the report
fields.ad: one-line situs address of the parcel (SanGIS); absent = no address on file
fields.pa: APN of the SanGIS parcel containing the point
fields.pq: no APN: s = section-level location, n = true point in no parcel
